representation_note: 3D model drawn from published catalog and literature values (each fact shows its source) - not an image. Sizes and distances may be exaggerated for visibility.

notes: Values checked on 2026-11-14 against the NASA Exoplanet Archive, SIMBAD (CfA mirror), Gaia DR3, VizieR and the cited papers (tasks/WS7-3d-systems.md, WS7-2). Facts still marked 'unverified' are estimates no source states.
Orbital and pulsation phases are arbitrary (no epoch): positions are not predictions for a real date.

The size/brightness animation is a sine wave spanning the V-band range: real Mira cycles are asymmetric, change from cycle to cycle and are much smaller in the infrared SPHEREx sees. It is not a measured or SPHEREx light curve.
Radial velocity −132.8 km/s from SIMBAD (Wilson 1953); optical lines of a Mira move with the pulsation.
